concept: SQS FIFO: strict ordering and exactly-once processing
tests: Which queue guarantees message ordering and exactly-once processing for financial transactions.
expected: SQS FIFO queue — ordering within a message group and exactly-once processing (deduplication). Triggers: "strict ordering", "exactly-once", "financial transactions".
why_not: SQS standard — at-least-once and best-effort ordering; SNS standard — no ordering guarantee; Firehose — delivery to storage, not transactional messaging.
